column1: # Mercenary dens (MERC-1, #83): how a den evolves and what it makes. Authored by
# us: every number is [A]. The client carries the SHAPE (evolution: a level
# that rises one per unit_increase_time_seconds, five stages by level band;
# infomorphs: a count per generation tick within a band of the development
# stage, capped; sovereignty/mercenaryden/client/repository.py:288-312 [V])
# but no numbers; the server sends the client these definitions. Read by the
# server (`merc_den::TABLE`); edit and restart; no re-extract needed.
# den_type_id: the den item type id this row is for, or 0 for every den type
# with no row of its own (a type id is an identifier, not a value).
# dens_per_skill_level: how many dens one trained level of the den-management
# skill allows (the maximum is level * this; the absolute maximum, level 5 *
# this).
# dev_unit_s, anarchy_unit_s: seconds per +1 level of development / anarchy
# (0 = the level never rises).
# dev_bands, anarchy_bands: 10 numbers, lower,upper for stage 1 then stage 2
# ... stage 5. The stage of a level is the highest stage whose lower bound it
# has reached.
# anarchy_workforce: 5 numbers, the workforce a den consumes in each anarchy
# stage (shown as a share of the planet's workforce).
# gen_tick_s: seconds between infomorph generation ticks.
# gen_bands: 10 numbers, lower,upper infomorphs per tick for development
# stage 1 ... 5. A tick makes a count in the band, fixed by (den, tick).
# cargo_cap: the most infomorphs a den holds.
# infomorph_type: the item type id of the infomorph (the client's
# typeEncryptedInfomorph, inventorycommon/const.py [V]).
# why: the [A] and its falsifier.
den_type_id

column12: [A] a level an hour, stages of ten levels, tens of infomorphs an hour at the top; falsifier: owner balance ruling or a den window whose figures disagree with these
